Brand Lookbook

Draft 01 · Private

01 · Essence
Old money habits. New ambition.

Sterling Row is a media-led house for ambitious founders. The look is quiet, corporate and elegant: warm dark rooms, tailored silence, one clear voice. It should feel like a private members' club that happens to teach you how to build.

Quiet

Space does the talking. A single mark, a single line, a single idea per piece.

Considered

Every detail has a reason: tracking, margins, crop. Nothing decorative without purpose.

Corporate, elevated

The discipline of a private bank with the warmth of an editorial house. Serious, never stiff.

Adapt or Perish
The House always wins
02 · Identity

One house, four marks.

The stag is the icon. The script SR is the monogram. Two wordmarks, serif and sans bold, handle names and sign-offs. Everything else has been retired.

Stag icon · Ink on Parchment
Stag icon · White on Midnight
SR monogram · Parchment on Maroon
Wordmark · Sans bold
Wordmark · Serif

Clear space

  • Keep one stag-body-height clear on all sides of the icon.
  • Monogram: clear space equals the height of the letter S.
  • Never place a mark on a busy area of a photograph.

Use

  • Monogram over photography, centred, white.
  • Stag on solid colour: Midnight, Maroon, Parchment.
  • Wordmark for names, sign-offs and the website header.

Never

  • Stretch, outline, shadow or recolour outside the palette.
  • Combine stag and monogram in one lockup (for now).
  • Set the monogram small. It needs room to breathe.
03 · Colour

Midnight, cognac, and a deep red.

Six colours, used in strict proportion. The maroon was sampled from the reference poster and is for statement pieces only.

Midnight#0D1B2ERGB 13 · 27 · 46Primary dark
Parchment#F1ECE0RGB 241 · 236 · 224Primary light
Silver#B9B8B2RGB 185 · 184 · 178Secondary text on dark
Cognac#8A4B2DRGB 138 · 75 · 45The single accent
Ink#0D0D0DRGB 13 · 13 · 13Text on light
Maroon#390700RGB 57 · 7 · 0Statement pieces
Parchment 38Midnight 30Maroon 10Ink 8Silver 8Cognac 6
AaParchment on Midnight · 14.7:1
AaParchment on Maroon · 14.8:1
AaCognac on Parchment · 5.7:1

Contrast ratios are calculated from the hex values. All three pairs pass the WCAG AA level (4.5:1) for normal text. Cognac stays an accent: use it for labels and rules, not long paragraphs.

04 · Typography

A serif that speaks, a grotesk that steadies.

Baskervville · Headlines and editorial
Ambition with discipline.

For headlines, pull quotes and the website. Set large, with tight leading and slightly negative tracking. Use sentence case.

Alte Haas Grotesk · Bold and Regular
THE FOUNDER KIT

Bold in capitals with wide tracking for labels, navigation and graphics. Regular for body copy and captions, always smaller than it feels it should be.

Label · Alte Haas Bold · caps · +24% tracking
Headline in Baskervville, set large and quiet.

Body in Alte Haas Regular, 17 to 18px on the web, generous line height. Short paragraphs, plain language, no jargon dressed up as authority.

Script SR is an artwork, not a typeface. Do not set any text in it.

05 · Imagery

Warm rooms, dark wood, leather, stillness.

Photographs are quiet interiors, cars, craft details and architecture, shot or graded warm and low. People are cropped or seen from behind. Nothing smiling at the camera.

GradeWarm, lowered, slightly desaturated. Black and white is allowed for people.
CropDetails over scenes: a hand, a seat, a stitch, a doorway.
OverlayDarken by roughly 45% with a soft vignette before placing type or a mark.
SourceThe Pinterest originals are for this private lookbook and drafts. Replace with licensed or original photography before you publish.

07 · Social graphics

Simple, centred, unhurried.

Thirteen starter graphics. Each has one idea, generous margins and one mark. The portrait posts are 1080 by 1350 and the stories are 1080 by 1920.

08 · Voice

Plain, confident, never loud.

We write like a senior partner explaining something to a bright friend. Short sentences, concrete nouns, no hype.

We say

  • Founders. Members. Intake.
  • Kit. Playbook. Review.
  • Ship it. Show the numbers.
  • Free to join.

We avoid

  • Hustle. Grind. Guru.
  • Coach. Mentor. Student.
  • Guaranteed funding.
  • Secret. Hack. Insane.
